top_signals.title: BOT Deputy Governor Plans to Normalize Rates
top_signals.summary:
Bank of Thailand Deputy Governor Piti Disyatat says the central bank will normalize rates at its own pace as the economy remains resilient. He spoke on the sidelines of the IMF-World Bank Annual Meetings in Bangkok.
 (Source: Bloomberg)
